rules.analysisBoundary: Sequential reuse of QueryAnalyzer, DiagnosticBag, DiagnosticContext and immutable Diagnostic copies; no concurrent sharing is claimed.
rules.deterministicIdentity: Repeated observations must match by code, severity, phase, source, message, span and structured payload.
rules.limitPolicy: The earliest useful root remains visible when later errors reach the configured limit; warnings are not suppressed by an error limit.
rules.payloadPolicy: Copy and formatter operations must preserve phase, source, primary and related locations, arguments, actions and correlation identifiers.
